name: gymops-demo
description: GymOps Tracker — gym & fitness studio ops platform demo across 4 roles and 5 branches, built by Novexa IT

paragraphs: A gym & fitness studio operations platform demo. Four roles — Gym Owner, Branch Manager, Trainer, and Front Desk Staff — each get a dashboard scoped to their job: memberships, class bookings, attendance, staff scheduling, a leads/CRM pipeline, payments, facility issues, and an audit trail, across five fictional branches.

This is a self-contained demo build. There is no backend, no database, no API keys, and no network calls other than fetching two web fonts. All domain data — members, bookings, payments, leads, issues — is generated client-side by a seeded random generator and held in React state for the lifetime of the tab. Clone it, run two commands, and every screen has realistic data on first load. Read the Architecture section for exactly how that works, including the one important caveat: it doesn't persist (see Persistence).
features: Which dashboard tabs a role sees is driven entirely by the roleTabs map in src/data/seed.ts — DashboardShell.tsx just renders whatever tabs that role's array lists, in order.
Gym Owner — overview · members · leads · payments · reports · auditLog · notifications · settings
Cross-branch KPIs: active members, renewals due, revenue this month, failed payments, audit entries logged
Branch performance snapshot (active members / revenue / check-ins per branch)
Revenue trend and membership status charts
